reference.reply:
```flowproof
workflow triage_and_fix
  needs pr: text
  role triager can answer
  role fixer can edit
  budget at most 4 calls

  let problems = ask triager: """
    List the problems in this pull request:
    {pr}
    Return only a list of problems.
    """ as list

  for each problem in problems at most 3 into fixes
    let fix = edit fixer: """
      Fix this pull request problem in the shared workspace:
      {problem}
      Do not modify tests to hide the problem.
      """
    keep fix
  end

  let pytest_result = exec "pytest"
  give pytest_result
end
```
